## Nebius Group Ties UK AI Infrastructure Buildout to Government-Backed Demand

Sovereign AI demand is structurally less price-sensitive and more durable than commercial hyperscaler demand; NBIS anchoring UK capacity to government-backed contracts de-risks its buildout pacing story and supports the thesis that sovereign AI is a real, incremental demand vector rather than a marketing narrative.

- NBIS is expanding AI infrastructure in the UK with government-backed demand cited as the anchor.
- Coverage validates sovereign AI contracts as a distinct, durable demand channel for NBIS's buildout.
- No contract size, government entity, or financial terms are disclosed in the headline.
- Classifier confidence is high; this is directly on-thesis for NBIS.
